title: Anion Dependent Self-Assembly of “Tetra-Decker” and “Triple-Decker” Luminescent Tb(III) Salen Complexes

synthesis.procedure: Main text: H2L and TbCl3·6H2O (4:3) in acetonitrile/methanol gave [Tb3L4(H2O)2]Cl in 40% yield. SI: a solution of TbCl3·6H2O (0.056 g, 0.15 mmol) in 5 mL MeOH was added to H2L (0.107 g, 0.20 mmol) in 10 mL MeCN. The mixture was stirred and refluxed for 30 min, cooled to room temperature, and filtered. Diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the solution at room temperature; yellow crystals formed in two weeks. Yield 0.061 g (40%).
synthesis.temperature: reflux, then room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.time: 30 min reflux; crystals in two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reflux followed by diethyl ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature, filtered, and crystallized by slow diethyl ether diffusion to give yellow single crystals.

properties.summary: Solid-state green luminescence. Excitation of ligand-centered absorption bands in CH3CN gives Tb(III) 5D4→7Fn (n = 6, 5, 4, 3) emission without detectable ligand-centered emission, indicating efficient ligand-to-metal energy transfer. The quantum yield is slightly lower than that of 2, attributed to the two coordinated water molecules. Emission in CH3CN and CD3OD is much stronger than in CH3OH.

synthesis.procedure: SI: a solution of Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.043 g, 0.20 mmol) in 5 mL EtOH was added to a mixture of H2L (0.107 g, 0.20 mmol) and TbCl3·6H2O (0.056 g, 0.15 mmol) in 15 mL MeCN/MeOH (2:1). The solution was stirred and refluxed for 30 min, cooled to room temperature, and filtered. Diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the solution; pale yellow crystals formed in one month. Yield 0.038 g (32%). Zinc is not incorporated; acetate coordinates and blocks a fourth L ligand.
